subject: Media Literacy
title: The Role of Media Literacy Education
description: A quick, practical guide to The Role of Media Literacy Education.

hook.text: Finland ranks #1 globally in media literacy. Not coincidentally, it also ranks #1 in resistance to misinformation.

buildup.text: Media literacy education teaches people to analyze, evaluate, and create media critically from a young age.

discovery.text: Countries that invest in media literacy show measurably lower susceptibility to propaganda and misinformation.

twist.text: Most education systems teach students to read text but not to read media — despite media being the primary information source.

climax.text: Media literacy isn't a nice-to-have. In an age of information warfare, it's a democratic necessity.

punchline.text: Teach people to read media and the misinformation loses its power.

quiz.question: What does Finland's experience demonstrate about media literacy?
options: Media literacy has no measurable effect
Investment in media literacy education correlates with resistance to misinformation
Only Nordic countries can achieve media literacy
